title: Brent: Price slide extends on pipeline restart – Danske Bank
summary: Danske Research Team notes Brent crude trading near USD 98/bbl after six straight sessions of declines, with Oil acting as the dominant intraday driver for broader markets.

title: Germany’s flash Manufacturing PMI unexpectedly drops to 53.8 in September
summary: German flash HCOB Manufacturing PMI has come in lower at 53.8 in September. The data was expected to arrive higher at 54.5 from 54.3 in August. However, the overall business activity remain stronger-than-expected due to robust Services PMI data.

title: Equities: Flat close with sector rotation – Deutsche Bank
summary: Deutsche Bank strategists note that United States (US) equities finished virtually flat, as strength in technology and semiconductor stocks offset a sharp decline in financials.

title: South Korea Aims to Cut Middle East Crude Reliance to 50% by 2035
summary: South Korea will try to cut its reliance on Middle East crude imports to 50% by 2035, Reuters has reported, citing the country’s industry ministry. The ministry has drafted a 10-year natural resource security plan, which envisages a “fundamental shift” in the way South Korea sources its imports. The plan also calls for a boost in oil reserves by some 20 million barrels by 2030. South Korea imports as much as 70% of its crude oil from Middle Eastern producers, and most of it must pass through the Strait of Hormuz, the ministry…
